title: Writing a Formal Letter
text:
I am writing to ask about the job advertised on your website. I have five years of experience in sales. I would like to attend an interview next week. Please contact me by email at any time. Thank you for your time.

A formal letter has a clear structure. It starts with the sender's address and the date. The greeting is usually 'Dear' followed by the name of the person. The letter ends with 'Yours sincerely' when the name is known. A good letter is polite and short.

questions.text: What is the writer asking about?
options: The job advertised on the website
A new house for the family
A course at a language school

questions.text: How does a formal letter start?
options: With the sender's address and the date

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer of the first paragraph?
options: They do not have any work experience.
They think they are qualified for the job.
They have already started working at the company.
They want to move to another country.

questions.text: What can we infer about a formal letter from the passage?
options: It should use slang and jokes.
It should always be sent by email.
It should be as long as possible.
It should be polite and short.

vocabulary.definition: knowledge or skill gained from doing a job
a formal meeting to ask questions and decide if someone is suitable for a job
words used at the start of a letter or conversation to say hello

paragraph_translations: Sayın Bay Brown, web sitenizde ilan edilen iş hakkında bilgi almak için yazıyorum. Satış alanında beş yıllık deneyimim var. Gelecek hafta bir mülakata katılmak istiyorum. Lütfen istediğiniz zaman e-posta ile benimle iletişime geçin. Zamanınız için teşekkür ederim.

Resmi bir mektubun açık bir yapısı vardır. Gönderenin adresi ve tarihle başlar. Selamlama genellikle 'Dear' ile başlar ve kişinin adı gelir. İsmi biliniyorsa mektup 'Yours sincerely' ile biter. İyi bir mektup kibar ve kısadır.
